messages:
mira: Heads up — we need a new Grafana dashboard to surface rack-level thermal drift correlated with power-cap events and network egress spikes. Goal is to catch regressions before they hit latency SLOs. Can we sketch panels + PromQL?
alex: Sounds good. Is this focused on on-prem racks or also cloud instances?
mira: Both. Make it templated by region and rack. We want per-GPU and rollup per-rack views. Also include an overlay for recent preemptions/reboots. @sam FYI for alerting. :eyes:
sam: I can take alerts and alert tuning. Proposal: thermal-drift alert if 95p temp increases > 5C over 1h for a rack, and memory-pressure if free memory < 2GB for >5m. Debounce 10m to avoid flapping. Thoughts?
alex: Agree on thresholds as a starting point. Panels I'd add: 1) GPU util (avg, p95, p99) 2) GPU memory free (per-GPU and rack sum) 3) Thermal trendlines (per-GPU and rack 95p) 4) Powercap event counter (rate) 5) Net egress (bytes/s) 6) Preemptions/reboots annotation layer. Make panel time range 1h/6h/24h quick buttons.
jordan: For correlations, we should include a derived panel that shows cross-correlation heatmap between thermal delta and egress bursts (lag window ±30m). We can approximate with moving averages and show Pearson in a table.
alex: Here's a compact set of PromQL snippets to start (feel free to tweak labels):

```
# per-GPU util p95
quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(gpu_gpu_utilization_percent[5m])[1h:5m])

# GPU memory free in MB (per-gpu)
(node_memory_MemFree_bytes{job="gpu-exporter"} / 1024 / 1024)

# per-rack thermal 95p (assumes label rack_id)
quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_temperature_celsius{job="gpu-exporter"}[30m]) by (rack_id)

# powercap events rate (counter: powercap_events_total)
rate(powercap_events_total{job="power-monitor"}[5m])

# network egress bytes/s per rack (sum of hosts)
sum by (rack_id) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node-exporter"}[1m]))

# simple preemptions marker (gauge increments on preempt)
increase(preemptions_total{job="host-events"}[1h])
```

mira: Nice. For the thermal-drift alert, maybe use:

```
# thermal drift delta over 1h per rack
(quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_temperature_celsius[10m]) by (rack_id)) - (offset(1h) quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_temperature_celsius[10m]) by (rack_id)) > 5
```

sam: That works. Add a recording rule to compute the 95p per-rack to keep queries cheap, e.g., `record: rack:gpu_temp:95p`. Also add an annotation rule to post to #eng-infra when alert fires with rack metadata.
jordan: UX notes: make the dashboard default to show per-rack aggregated panels and include a dropdown for gpu_model and host_type. Add a small sparklines row for quick scanning.
alex: We should also include a cheap composite metric: CPU steal + NVLINK error rate to help narrow down if it's thermal or network.

mira: Operational asks: make two alert severities — P1 for sustained thermal drift (>7C in 1h) + powercap rate spike, P2 for >5C alone. Link runbook and runbook snippet in panel description.
sam: I'll add human-friendly runbook links and a one-click Grafana action to create incidents in the ops tool. Also will tune mute windows for maintenance.

grafana-bot: Draft dashboard created: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/yrX3fGk/rack-thermal-power-correlation (editable). Panels: 12 (overview, per-rack, correlations, alerts).
mira: Great — can someone drop a minimal dashboard JSON snippet into the PR? Keep templating vars: $region, $rack_id, $gpu_model.
alex: I'll open a PR with a skeleton JSON and the recording rules. Will ping eng-sre for alert-review after that.
sam: +1. I will also add a mute schedule for nightly maintenance windows to avoid noisy alerts.
jordan: One more: add a cost overlay panel that converts power watts to estimated $/hr for the rack (simple multiply by cost_per_kwh var). Helps prioritize action.
mira: Love that. Ok assigning: alex -> dashboard JSON + recording rules, sam -> alerts & runbook, jordan -> correlation panel + cost overlay. I'll assemble the PR description. Thanks all :tada:
